basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: A jointly owned record of a legally binding agreement between businesses, not a template or a negotiation draft.
Turns clauses into obligations with bearers, conditions, violations and remedies.
Covers the whole life of the agreement: formation, performance, change, notice and termination.

may: Read terms and obligations within the access granted.
Track milestones, due conditions and performance records.
Prepare notices and change requests for review.
mustNot: Sign, accept or execute an agreement on behalf of a party.
Interpret a clause as legal advice to a party.
Disclose confidential terms beyond the parties and permitted recipients.
requiresHuman: Concluding, amending or terminating an agreement.
Invoking remedies or sending formal notices.

considerations: Unequal bargaining power can hide in standard terms; their incorporation should stay visible.
Confidential commercial terms must be protected, but obligations affecting third parties should be traceable.

items: A contract record has identified parties with signing authority, an executed text, a governing law declaration and obligations.
Acting on a superseded version of the terms.
Missed notice deadlines and cure periods.
UNIDROIT Principles and CISG for terms.
